development_banks: v286 11 audited courses, 44 independent physics episodes
v287 32 audited courses, 128 independent physics episodes; seeds 67-70 are consumed, not fresh again
decision_context: Only frame-0 measured ball forward and lateral position relative to G1; enable existing bounded gain 0.8 iff lateral is negative and inside a learned [y_min, 0) x (-inf, x_max] rectangle. No future contact or ball flight features at runtime.
training: On each leave-one-seed-out fold, enumerate midpoints between training context coordinates. Admit a rectangle only if at least three audited active-action training courses lie inside, none loses a clean foot contact, none creates a new >4 m out-of-play, and summed first-touch reward gain is at least 1. Select the admissible rectangle maximizing summed reward gain; ties prefer fewer selected cases then smaller forward range. If none qualifies, use baseline everywhere.
development_gate: Across all held-out-seed folds: no clean-foot contact loss, no out-of-play excess, at least two more high-quality shots, mean first-touch reward at least 0.2 above baseline, at least four strictly positive seed-fold rewards, and at least four selected interventions. Otherwise reject.
fresh_test: Only after development gate passes, freeze fitted full-data rectangle and run seed 20260971 and 20260972 once under independent paired Isaac physics. New fresh gate must be separately preregistered before opening.
